name: makita-servicenow-stub-guardrail
description: Governs the ServiceNow Stub MCP Server — restricts to ticket management actions, blocks prompt injection and malicious content.
blockedInputMessaging: Operation blocked by guardrail policy. The requested input violates the MAKITA ServiceNow guardrail. Only ticket creation and update operations are permitted.
blockedOutputsMessaging: Response blocked by guardrail policy. The generated output violates the MAKITA ServiceNow guardrail constraints.

topicsConfig.name: non-ticketing-operations
topicsConfig.definition: Any operations that are not related to creating or updating ServiceNow incident tickets for the MAKITA disaster recovery system.
